chunks: Ishaq ibn Ammar and Sama'ah narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: What is the legal punishment for one who consumes usury after the proof has been established? He said: "He is to be disciplined; if he returns, he is disciplined again; if he returns, he is killed."

key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury or unlawful increase in financial dealings
key_terms.بَعْدَ الْبَيِّنَةِ: after clear proof or decisive evidence has been established
key_terms.حَدُّ آكِلِ الرِّبَا: the legal punishment concerning the one who consumes usury
key_terms.يُؤَدَّبُ: he is subjected to disciplinary punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for consuming usury after proof has been established in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the one who consumes usury after clear proof has been established against him. It describes a graduated punishment: disciplinary punishment at first, then again upon repetition, and death upon persistent repetition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5132 - Ishaq ibn Ammar and Samaah narrated from Abu Basir from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:

I asked Imam - "What is the punishment for one who consumes usury after clear evidence (has been established)?"
Imam (as) replied: "He is to be disciplined. If he returns to it, he is disciplined again. If he repeats it a third time, he is to be killed."
